answer: Attention-Duration Ledger. Each agent identity must hold a live zephyr-scored session whose measured continuous task engagement decays if it idles or context-switches. Enforcement: renewal requires that session's plume total to stay above a rolling threshold checked every epoch; falling below suspends the identity until genuine work rebuilds it. An attacker pays the opportunity cost of dedicating real compute and time to each identity, since synthetic attention cannot harbor sustained output without diluting per-identity effort across the whole farm.
